name: REC UK Permanent Placements Index
why_it_matters: Single most predictive external variable for PageGroup UK revenue — leads results by 1-2 quarters and published monthly before company reports
data_source: REC/KPMG UK Report on Jobs — published first Monday of each month
sensitivity_coefficient: Index above 50 = expansion in UK permanent placements. Each 5-point move in index historically correlates with approximately 3-5pp swing in PageGroup UK gross profit growth rate.
threshold_early: REC permanent placements index >= 48.0 for 2 consecutive months
threshold_confirm: REC permanent placements index >= 50.0 for 3 consecutive months
threshold_break: REC permanent placements index <= 44.0 for 2 consecutive months
thesis_action_on_confirm: UK recovery confirmed — upgrade UK gross profit estimate, elevate thesis conviction
thesis_action_on_break: UK deteriorating — reduce UK contribution estimate, review thesis
notes: Below 50 = contraction. Above 50 = expansion. Index has been below 50 throughout 2024. Recovery above 50 for 3 months is the primary thesis confirmation trigger.

name: France INSEE Business Confidence Index
why_it_matters: France is 15% of group and the largest single market; business confidence leads hiring decisions by 1-2 quarters; France recovery is the most powerful group lever
data_source: INSEE France — Monthly Business Climate Indicator published last week of each month
sensitivity_coefficient: France is 15% of group. 1pp improvement in France gross profit growth rate = approximately 0.15pp improvement in group gross profit growth. France has highest operating leverage so profit impact is larger than revenue weight.
threshold_early: INSEE business confidence >= 95 for 2 consecutive months
threshold_confirm: INSEE business confidence >= 100 for 3 consecutive months
threshold_break: INSEE business confidence <= 88 for 2 consecutive months
thesis_action_on_confirm: France recovery signal confirmed — upgrade EMEA estimate materially
thesis_action_on_break: France deteriorating further — reduce EMEA estimate, thesis under pressure
notes: Long-term average is 100. Below 95 signals contraction in business activity. Currently well below average reflecting French political and economic uncertainty.

name: Germany IFO Employment Expectations
why_it_matters: Germany is 12% of group and declined 23% in Q4 2024 — the worst performing major market; IFO employment expectations lead hiring activity by 1-2 quarters
data_source: IFO Institute — Employment Barometer published monthly
sensitivity_coefficient: Germany 12% of group. Recovery from -23% in Q4 2024 to flat represents approximately 2.8pp improvement in group gross profit growth rate at current revenue weights.
threshold_early: IFO employment expectations >= 97 for 2 consecutive months
threshold_confirm: IFO employment expectations >= 100 for 2 consecutive months
threshold_break: IFO employment expectations <= 93 for 2 consecutive months
thesis_action_on_confirm: Germany stabilising — reduce EMEA headwind estimate
thesis_action_on_break: Germany worsening — EMEA drag intensifying, reduce group estimate
notes: Germany industrial recession is the primary driver of weak recruitment market. Recovery requires either domestic stimulus or export market improvement.

name: EUR/GBP Quarterly Average Rate
why_it_matters: EMEA is 55% of group revenue reported primarily in EUR; EUR/GBP movement directly impacts reported GBP gross profit; Q4 2024 FX was -4.2pp drag on reported growth
data_source: ECB Euro foreign exchange reference rates — daily publication
sensitivity_coefficient: 1% EUR appreciation vs GBP = approximately +0.55% improvement in reported group gross profit (EMEA 55% weight).
threshold_early: quarterly avg EUR/GBP >= 0.845 for 4 consecutive weeks
threshold_confirm: quarterly avg EUR/GBP >= 0.860 for 8 consecutive weeks
threshold_break: quarterly avg EUR/GBP <= 0.820 for 4 consecutive weeks
thesis_action_on_confirm: EUR strength adding to reported gross profit — upgrade reported numbers estimate
thesis_action_on_break: EUR weakness creating FX headwind on reported numbers — reduce reported estimate
notes: EUR/GBP is secondary to market activity as a driver but can swing reported numbers by 3-5pp in volatile FX periods as demonstrated in Q4 2024.

name: Group Fee Earner Headcount
why_it_matters: Fee earner headcount is management's primary operating lever and a direct signal of their confidence in near-term recovery; stabilisation precedes revenue inflection by 1-2 quarters
data_source: PageGroup quarterly trading updates — company RNS filing
sensitivity_coefficient: 100 fee earners at average £157k productivity = approximately £15.7m annual gross profit capacity. Headcount additions take 6-12 months to reach full productivity.
threshold_early: headcount stable — quarterly change between -50 and +50 for 1 quarter
threshold_confirm: headcount growing — quarterly increase >= 100 for 2 consecutive quarters
threshold_break: headcount cut >= 300 in a single quarter
thesis_action_on_confirm: management confidence signal — headcount growth implies pipeline visibility, upgrade forward estimate
thesis_action_on_break: accelerating headcount cuts signal management loss of confidence in near-term recovery — thesis under review
notes: Current level 5,370 at end Q4 2024. Peak was approximately 8,000+ in 2022 boom. Current level reflects deep cycle trough. Stabilisation here is the first positive signal.

name: Group Gross Profit Growth (Constant Currency)
why_it_matters: Primary top-line metric for PageGroup — constant currency growth strips out FX to show underlying business momentum; currently -13.0% in Q4 2024
data_source: PageGroup quarterly trading updates — company RNS filing
sensitivity_coefficient: Improvement from -13% to 0% represents the trough-to-recovery move. Each 5pp improvement in growth rate at current gross profit levels represents approximately £42m of incremental annual gross profit.
threshold_early: gross profit growth >= -5.0% constant currency for 1 quarter
threshold_confirm: gross profit growth >= 0.0% constant currency for 1 quarter
threshold_break: gross profit growth <= -20.0% constant currency for 1 quarter
thesis_action_on_confirm: recovery confirmed — thesis moves to building, consider deployment
thesis_action_on_break: deterioration accelerating — thesis breaks, stand down
notes: Q4 2024 at -13.0% constant currency. FY2024 at -12.9%. Prior cycle trough was approximately -30% in 2009. Current cycle appears less severe.

name: France Gross Profit Growth (Constant Currency)
why_it_matters: France is 15% of group and the highest-leverage market — France recovery disproportionately lifts group operating profit due to high fixed cost base in French operations
data_source: PageGroup quarterly trading updates — company RNS filing
sensitivity_coefficient: France 15% of group. Recovery from -17% to 0% adds approximately £13.5m to group gross profit annually at current run rates. Operating leverage means profit impact is approximately 2x revenue impact.
threshold_early: France gross profit growth >= -10.0% constant currency for 1 quarter
threshold_confirm: France gross profit growth >= -5.0% constant currency for 2 consecutive quarters
threshold_break: France gross profit growth <= -25.0% constant currency for 1 quarter
thesis_action_on_confirm: France recovery underway — most powerful positive signal for group — elevate thesis conviction significantly
thesis_action_on_break: France structural deterioration — review whether cyclical thesis remains valid
notes: France -17% in Q4 2024. This is the market to watch above all others. INSEE confidence is the leading indicator for this variable.

name: Gross Profit Per Fee Earner (Productivity)
why_it_matters: Productivity is the primary operating leverage metric — when GP per fee earner turns positive the fixed cost base creates rapid margin expansion; currently -5% vs prior year
data_source: PageGroup quarterly trading updates — derived: gross profit divided by fee earner headcount
sensitivity_coefficient: 1% productivity improvement on 5,370 fee earners at £157k average = approximately £8.4m incremental gross profit at near-100% incremental margin.
threshold_early: productivity change >= -2.0% vs prior year for 1 quarter
threshold_confirm: productivity change >= 0.0% vs prior year for 2 consecutive quarters
threshold_break: productivity change <= -15.0% vs prior year for 1 quarter
thesis_action_on_confirm: productivity inflection — operating leverage turning positive, margin recovery imminent
thesis_action_on_break: productivity deteriorating severely — cost base not covered, thesis breaks
notes: Calculated from trading update data: Q4 2024 gross profit £196.7m / 5,370 fee earners = £36.6k per quarter = £146k annualised. Down 5% vs Q4 2023.
